div.div:
Planned persistence decisions
Runs retain independent state and source versions; a failed analysis never replaces the transcript.
Selection records refer to original deck indexes; repeated visits remain in Attempt JSON.
Deletion blocks new work, cleans dependent rows in order, then retries file cleanup from a durable manifest.
Descriptions remain deck-scoped. Existing coaching snapshots need a practiced-scope projection (Section 8.3).
